posts.title: ebnf & parser of PTX from sdk 13.4
posts.description: Observing raw data from previous part we can conclude that many (17) new attributes were inserted in middle of indices table thereby shifting the indices. And even worse - they were inserted in many arbitrary places. So instead of patching long-suffering script iptx.pl I made its clone iptx3.pl (DRY, yeah) After some brute-forcing & RE I was able to identify 130 attributes masks - so still unknown
